scope: Read recorded raw03 metadata and verified upstream source; reproduce actual Agent tick/request semantics using isolated pure fake browser and HTTP client. No live/frozen source edits or actors.
implementation_decision: Compile verified original Agent/model/questions/browser bytes in a private fixture package. Use fake Browser and HTTP dependencies that raise on actual CDP/network calls. Show missing failure context in model body under unchanged page/history. Propose separate generic stale-attempt context without changing action history, candidate inventory, judge, or action safety guards.
planned_tests: Repeated pre-input StalePage leaves three next model requests equal and action history unchanged.
Changed page changes next request even without rejection feedback.
Stale post-action observation preserves the executed action entry.
Proposed context only adds one separate state field, changing request bytes without modifying actions/candidates/questions.
performance_claim: Mechanism/provenance proof only; no model improvement or scenario-success claim.
